If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, add 0.5–1.0 to forecasted price in mid-horizon (days 15–25) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, subtract 0.5–1.0 from forecasted price in mid-horizon (days 15–25) to offset bearish pressure.

If sentiment swings from positive to negative within 5 days, reduce forecast slope in late horizon (days 25–30) by 10–20% to reflect sentiment reversal risk.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, increase forecast by 0.3–0.7 in late horizon (days 25–30) to capture momentum continuation.

If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, reduce forecast by 0.3–0.7 in late horizon (days 25–30) to reflect weakening momentum.

If sentiment is volatile (alternating 0.33–0.67) in last 5 days, apply smoothing filter to forecast path in mid-horizon (days 15–25) to dampen erratic swings.
